title: Privileged-Pooling-inspired mechanism gate on frozen CLIP patches
purpose: Determine whether replacing additive local logits by canonical supervised attention pooling creates a sufficient full-part Oracle ceiling before any MNAR correction.

reference.paper: Rodriguez et al., Fine-grained Species Recognition with Privileged Pooling, TPAMI 2023

arms.CLIP_CLS_GLOBAL: Reuse train-only OOF predictions from PAT-C-260728-001 as the strongest existing global reference.
arms.PATCH_AVG: Mean pool the same final patch tokens and train one linear classifier.
arms.PRPOOL_ORACLE: Predict four supervised and one complementary sigmoid attention maps with a 3x3 convolutional head; average-pool and L2-normalize each attention-weighted feature; concatenate the five vectors; use a single classifier with no additive global or local residual.

attention.head: Conv3x3(768,256)-ReLU-Conv3x3(256,5)
attention.part_loss: mean BCE over max-pooled scales with kernel sizes 1,2,4,7
attention.complementary_regularizer: maximize a_bar*(1-a_bar) to avoid constant maps

selection_hierarchy: Select PATCH_AVG learning rate and weight decay by five-fold train OOF.
Hold those settings fixed and select PRPOOL_ORACLE part and complementary regularizer weights by five-fold train OOF.
If objectives tie within 1e-8, choose lower part-loss weight and then lower regularizer weight.

go_no_go.reason_for_2_5pp_margin: PAT-C-260728-001 showed that a 2pp OOF gain shrank to 0.74pp on validation; the new mechanism must clear a larger train-only margin.
go_no_go.on_go: Freeze the chosen architecture and only then define a new validation audit; do not use validation to change the mechanism.
go_no_go.on_no_go: Frozen CLIP patch-head mechanisms are exhausted; next admissible change is limited end-to-end backbone adaptation or stopping PartImageNet method development.
